sourceFile: 28. TIU C11-20  Report Test Frame #1-B improve damage mesh 2026.03.31. - RAW soundcheck_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft is comparable but misidentifies the changed factor and includes unreliable measurement groupings.
issues: Changed condition incorrectly set to Day shift; shift is context, not factor.
Primary comparison should be Frame Test Mold #1-B versus Normal/Normal L.
Measurement outcomes mix header/spec/frequency rows as data.
Decision row supporting usability/improvement is not cited.
Review title is an extracted raw header, not a concise case title.
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to Frame Test Mold #1-B improvement versus Normal baseline.
Move date, shift, model, and mold number to subgroup/context keys.
Rebuild SPL/THD measurement outcomes from actual frequency rows and averages only.
Keep function defect result as a separate outcome under the same factor.
Add decision/purpose citations including Test!2, Test!6, and Test!35.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but they do not sufficiently support the current grouping.
